answer: Proof of Stake serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism where validator influence scales with capital commitment. Like a gale sweeping away weak nodes, the protocol forces attackers to purchase massive stakes, akin to the sharp-eyed falcon tracking asset flows to maintain network security. Participation requires a yarrow-like root system of locked tokens; for an adversary, the cost of subversion is the acquisition of a majority share of the total supply, rendering Sybil expansion economically irrational.
